capabilities: Clean up Markdown in a note or selection
Apply text transformations to selected text
Run AI writing commands on notes
Buy and track AI credits through a Constance account
Restore the original note when a queued edit batch is interrupted
extras: Account, credits and payment run through the Constance v2 service with Paddle; startup and error reports go to Datadog. The README covers billing, privacy and recovery rather than the available transformations or commands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to clean up Markdown or rewrite a selection with AI in a single command.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.
New purchases use Paddle and USD.

summary: Applies Markdown clean-up, text transformations and AI writing commands to a selection or note, with credits bought through a Constance account.
